activities: Read the four current skill files and targeted references.
Compared G1/G2/G4 documentation with current source-builder, field-adapter and evaluator code.
Checked claims against existing original-model and generic-campaign evidence; did not create a native COMSOL run.
Created only this review receipt; no production, skill, authority-document or peer-owned changes.

findings.issue: The old example implied that native datasets and solutions belong under component-qualified paths.
findings.correction: Current example preserves actual model-level dataset/solution tags and observed parent links. Component ownership is linked evidence, not an invented native collection path.

findings.issue: The converter accepts a nonempty caller evidence string; it does not dereference or authenticate an embedded witness path/hash. Canonical containment or equality to an old case cannot alone prove the native selection/export side.
findings.correction: Current documents explicitly assign witness file/hash and native domain/side/export verification to existing inspection/preparation. Unresolved native scope permits a declared numerical conversion/analogue only.
findings.evidence_limit: This documentation repair does not supply the missing native scope witness or promote legacy converted data to native-field reproduction.

findings.issue: Disabling a native particle-temperature auxiliary equation does not establish T_surface=T_gas.
findings.correction: Current preparation guidance records the equal-temperature collision-law closure explicitly. Missing heat capacity, initial/internal temperature or energy exchange inputs block a physical thermal claim; these are not mandatory inputs for every extraction or numerical conversion.
findings.scope_limit: Mean-force or collision-moment agreement remains conditional on the specified bath/surface closure and does not validate particle heating or phase stability.

findings.issue: A stale thermal-only RZ inventory description contradicted the current selected-field v3 adapter.
findings.correction: Current description states static nodal XY/RZ, one selected volume, explicit field mapping and unsupported layouts. Reduced electrostatic construction is separately identified as RZ and does not define the adapter's general scope.

findings.issue: The initially reviewed evaluator could report scoped parity using supported meaning/cohort and finest cross-solver differences without qualifying each participant's self-sensitivity.
findings.consequence: Two unresolved but mutually agreeing finest samples could receive this scoped parity PASS. The tool already denies rigorous error bounds and same-accuracy claims; the gap is numerical qualification of the parity label.
findings.remaining_manual_requirement: The gate is a conservative empirical prerequisite. It does not reconstruct hidden particle/event/safety subdivisions, authenticate a CSV-native execution, or supply native accepted-step/reference uncertainty evidence. A source-bound native evaluation remains necessary for its qualified comparison.
findings.acceptance_limit: Even after this gate, step-pair changes are empirical sensitivity, not certified error bounds, physical validity, event accuracy or stochastic equivalence.
findings.correction: Final v3 gates parity on separately registered candidate/reference self_sensitivity_budgets, both medium-to-fine target verdicts, common run start/end, strictly increasing actual accepted macro counts, and more than one coarsest base step in the selected observation window. Missing/exceeded allowances or unsupported macro evidence leave qualified parity NOT_TESTED.

tests_read: identical finest paths cannot hide failed self allowances
public result actual macro counts support the empirical gate
distinct dt labels with one macro remain NOT_TESTED
globally refined runs with one late-release interval remain NOT_TESTED

findings.issue: Increasing full-run macro counts and a refined finest step alone did not establish three useful refinements for a cohort released late in the run.
findings.correction: The coarsest base step must cover the selected observation window more than once. The public-API regression keeps the 6.5-to-8-second late cohort NOT_TESTED despite full-run macro counts [2,4,8]. This does not affect the current A/P full 30 ms cohorts.

reviewed_checks.basis: Extraction, case preparation, trajectory evaluation and visualization have separate owners and independently useful completion scopes. Reuse of verified identities prevents redundant complete workflows.

Active selector, velocity/momentum/energy conversion, component basis, moving-frame uncertainty, realized mass, distributions and release time are distinguished. The current builder's numeric static two-component scope is explicit.
Documentation does not imply implemented thermal/angle/surface sampling. Nonzero third components and dynamic/unknown frames need explicit resolution or an unsupported verdict.

reviewed_checks.topic: Three-level self sensitivity versus saved-pair comparison
reviewed_checks.basis: Three actual input/run levels serve self sensitivity; two saved participants serve raw comparison. No artificial third native resolution or reference precision target is required.
Equal seed/ID does not establish coupled random histories. Noise/model differences preserve raw descriptive comparisons while full parity and statistical equivalence remain unqualified.

Native final status is not instantaneous lifecycle. Frozen tails, missing rows, terminal cause, axis seams and joint pre-contact masks are distinguished; point versus particle-surface contact is explicit.
No source diameter, population count, charge, boundary ID, seed or step from A/P is adopted as a new-case default. Historical hard-coded tools are identified as case-bound.

Configured mathematical reproduction, physical applicability policy, external field/initial-condition conversion and production processing are separate. A/P differences alone do not prove an integrator/event defect.

not_claimed: New native domain-selection or export-side verification.
Physical validation of high-drift heating, nonlinear diffusion or thermophoresis.
New core algorithm tests or campaign execution performed by this review.
Exact reconstruction of all accepted particle/stochastic/event stage partitions from macro counts.

independent_numeric_review.recomputed_from: Normalized CSV using Python standard library and NumPy only; no repository analysis, evaluator or solver imports.
independent_numeric_review.checked: Both cases, six participants, explicit 287 IDs x 121 saved clocks; all seven comparisons, global precontact maxima/ID/time, equal-row RMS and retained counts, selected-time metrics, exact x/v/Z initial equality, missingness, separate named final lifecycle histograms, and shared-three-level RMS ratios.
independent_numeric_review.interpretation: Observed numerical sensitivity and original-versus-analogue differences only. No fate-to-accuracy inference, stochastic path pairing, physical validation or strict error bound.

final_source_review.conclusion: Current reviewed skill/document/tool contracts separate extraction, numeric transfer, model correspondence, empirical resolution and descriptive comparisons. No additional concrete defect was found after the recorded corrections.
final_source_review.execution_limit: No core change, new COMSOL run or simulation was performed by this final review.

verified_claim_limits: Joint precontact mask is stated as first material contact.
Same-h method changes are separated from different-h comparisons.
Finite-difference sensitivity is not an absolute error bound or physical validation.
Single Maxwell pseudogas, sigma=0.9 and prescribed Tw=Tg explicitly qualify collision-moment ratios.
Unresolved native frame, native-field transfer scope, nonlinear noise/thermal closure and physical 3D remain explicit.
report_claim_review.excluded: Visual rendering, all HTML link/image execution, and future regeneration of the report are root-owned QA.
